subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 8.
solution:
The correct answer is 'just.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence "***For him, each sufferer was more than ___(8)___ a case that was to be cured***'' is indicating thinking of Pasteur on sufferers.
 
• The use of the word ''case'' in the sentence indicates **an instance of a disease, injury, or problem**.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to be filled in the blank is 'just'.
 
• The word 'just' means **only**. 
 
 
• Example:* An entrepreneur is more than **just** a risk-taker*.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Complete Sentence: *For him, each sufferer was more than **just** a case that was to be cured*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let us explore the other options:

 
 
• 'But' is used **for introducing an idea that contrasts with or is different from what has just been said**. (किंतु, परंतु, लेकिन)
 
• 'Absolutely' means **completely; totally**. (पूरी तरह से; सर्वथा; संपूर्ण रूप से)
 
• 'Exactly' means **in exact terms; without vagueness**. (सटीक शब्दों में; अस्पष्टता के बिना)

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य "*For him, each sufferer was more than ___(8)___ a case that was to be cured*'' पीड़ितों पर पाश्चर की सोच का संकेत दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में ''case'' शब्द का प्रयोग **किसी बीमारी, चोट या समस्या के उदाहरण को इंगित करता है**।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'just' है।
 
• 'Just' शब्द का अर्थ है केवल।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *An entrepreneur is more than just a risk-taker*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।

पूर्ण वाक्य: *For him, each sufferer was more than just a case that was to be cured*.
